# Taraka Vishnumolakala

> Security architecture and research across security system design, application and API security, cloud security, ML security, agentic systems, and threat modeling.

## Agentic Security Architecture

- [Securing Agentic Architecture: Risks and Potential Mitigations](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/blog/securing-agentic-architecture.md): An evidence-based Reveal.js field guide to 53 agentic architecture risks, their credible impacts, synthesized baseline severities, and enforceable mitigations.

## MCP Security Series

- [Threat-Modeling MCP's Server Features](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/blog/mcp-security-server-features.md): Part 1 of the MCP Security series. A feature-by-feature threat model of Tools, Resources, Prompts, and the server-side utilities MCP added in 2025-11-25.

## Knowledge Base

- [Math Foundations](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations.md): Beginner-friendly, interactive lessons for building an intuition for the math used in machine learning.
- [Dataset Splits and Leakage](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/data-splits-and-leakage.md): A working model for separating training, validation, and test data without letting evaluation information influence the model.
- [Gradient Descent](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/gradient-descent.md): Learn how a model improves by changing a number, checking its error, and repeating.
- [Sigmoid & ReLU](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/sigmoid-and-relu.md): See how two small functions reshape a neuron’s raw number, and why neural networks use them in different places.
- [Softmax](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/softmax.md): Learn how a model turns several competing scores into probability shares that add up to 100%.
- [Cross-Entropy Loss](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/cross-entropy-loss.md): Learn how classification training penalizes a model for giving too little probability to the correct answer.
- [Linear Regression (Forward Pass)](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/linear-regression-forward.md): Follow a linear model from one input through multiplication and addition to a numerical prediction.
- [Linear Regression (Training)](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/ml-engineering/math-foundations/linear-regression-training.md): See how a linear model learns its weight and bias by measuring prediction errors and repeatedly reducing them.
- [Request Trust Boundaries](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/web-application-security/request-trust-boundaries.md): Notes for identifying where a web request crosses identities, parsers, services, and authorization decisions.
- [Context-Aware Test Payloads](https://taraka-vishnumolakala.github.io/knowledge/security-payloads/context-aware-test-payloads.md): A defensive approach to designing inert test inputs that reveal parsing, encoding, reflection, and trust-boundary behavior.
